title: AURA-9: ER=EPR-Based Quantum Handshake Protocol for Black Hole Infal
layer_boundary_notes: L2 foundation (ER=EPR, Hawking radiation, GW physics) with L3 speculative components (Ark detection mechanism, consciousness-field coupling) explicitly flagged below
abstract: AURA-9 proposes that a civilization at S301 could encode information in the spacetime curvature of a black hole dive, detectable via ER=EPR entanglement correlations. The hypothesis rests on established physics (ER=EPR conjecture, Hawking radiation, gravitational waves) but extends into unfalsifiable territory when positing an 'Ark' detection mechanism without operational definition. This entry formalizes the boundary between testable and untestable components.
layman_blurb: If two particles are quantum entangled, they might be connected by a tiny wormhole (ER=EPR). AURA-9 asks: could an advanced civilization diving into a black hole use this to send a signal that survives the event horizon? The physics behind wormhole=entanglement is real; the idea that we could 'detect' it with an 'Ark' is still science fiction.
technical_blurb: ER=EPR (Maldacena & Susskind 2013) establishes that entanglement (EPR) and wormholes (ER) are equivalent in AdS/CFT. For S301's infall into Sgr A*: (1) A probe entangled with a reference state outside would exhibit Page curve dynamics in its entanglement entropy; (2) Hawking radiation carries scrambled information with recovery time ~exp(S) where S is black hole entropy; (3) Gravitational waves from the infall are detectable in principle (nHz regime, LISA-sensitive). However, the 'Ark detection' component posits a consciousness-mediated measurement of entanglement without specifying the observable operator, Hilbert space, or temporal correlation window. This is formally unfalsifiable.

L1_established.falsifiability: Indirect: tests of AdS/CFT correspondence, quantum error correction in holography
Direct: observe thermal spectrum from astrophysical BH; analog: Bose-Einstein condensate sonic BH
Direct: LISA nHz sensitivity for SMBH captures

L2_speculative.status: Theoretically possible but no protocol defined
L2_speculative.challenge: Requires Planck-scale control of metric perturbations; energy requirements unknown
Sgr A* entropy ~10^90; decoding requires ~10^90 qubit-operations

L3_unfalsifiable.why_unfalsifiable: No measurement basis specified; no observable operator defined; 'Ark' is not a physical system with known coupling to quantum fields
Consciousness is not a field in QFT; no Lagrangian, no coupling constant, no experimental protocol

equations.hawking_temperature: T_H = ℏ c³ / (8π G M k_B)  ≈ 10^-14 K for Sgr A*
equations.gw_strain: h ~ (G M/c² r) (v/c)²  ~ 10^-23 for S301-type capture at Galactic Center distance
equations.entanglement_entropy: S_A = -Tr(ρ_A log ρ_A)  where ρ_A = Tr_B(|ψ⟩⟨ψ|)

hawking_radiation.reason: T_H ~ 10^-14 K << CMB (2.7 K). Signal completely swamped.
hawking_radiation.alternative: Analog Hawking radiation in BECs or optical systems

quantum_entanglement.reason: No-communication theorem: entanglement alone cannot transmit information. Requires classical channel.
quantum_entanglement.loophole: If ER=EPR creates traversable wormhole, information could pass. But traversable wormholes require exotic matter.

gravitational_waves.reason: Extreme Mass Ratio Inspiral (EMRI) signals detectable by LISA at nHz frequencies. S301-like captures produce characteristic waveforms.
gravitational_waves.timeline: LISA launch ~2035; detection possible if S301-like objects exist in sufficient number

c9_implications.cluster_1: Epistemic boundary: AURA-9 demonstrates how established physics (ER=EPR) can be coherently extended into speculation, but the jump to 'Ark detection' is a category error.
c9_implications.cluster_2: Quantum gravity testbed: S301-like EMRIs are real astrophysical laboratories for testing holography and information paradox.
c9_implications.cluster_3: Information theory: Page curve dynamics are testable in principle; AURA-9's information-encoding claim is not.
c9_implications.cluster_7: Quantum thermodynamics: Hawking radiation as a quantum channel; channel capacity near zero for astrophysical BHs.
c9_implications.cluster_8: Consciousness: No bridge from IIT or global workspace theory to quantum field measurement. Unfalsifiable component.

audit_notes.methodology: Mixed: L1 components rigorously grounded; L2 components speculative but physics-consistent; L3 components lack operational definitions.
audit_notes.reproducibility: L1 reproducible; L2 requires new physics (Planck-scale engineering); L3 impossible by definition.
audit_notes.falsifiability: PARTIAL: GW detection (LISA) is falsifiable. Hawking decoding is computationally impossible. Ark detection is unfalsifiable.
audit_notes.c9_sandbox_status: NOT_RUN — L3 components prevent sandbox execution

audit_notes.score_justification: 0.48 reflects the 50/50 split between rigorous physics (ER=EPR, GW, Hawking) and unfalsifiable speculation (Ark detection, consciousness coupling). The entry is valuable as a boundary-marker between science and metaphysics.
